parsed.headline: Claim denied: No signed written order (SWO) on file.
parsed.explanation: The claim is denied because there was no completed SWO on file at the time of billing. The governing policy states: "If the supplier bills for an item addressed in this policy without first receiving a completed SWO, the claim shall be denied as not reasonable and necessary."
parsed.what_to_do: Obtain a completed SWO and resubmit the claim if appropriate.
